item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-07-18
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 Spark Program 继续是绝对主角，委员会密集回应了多份提案，部分进入 Pending 待修改状态、一份 AI 辅助开发工具被拒，同时社区迎来了两个值得注意的新项目：面向 WooCommerce 的 Fiber 支付网关提案，以及一个名为 Myelin 的链下 Cell 会话运行时。 [S01, S03, S05, S08, S15] ## 重点话题 **Fiber 支付生态双线推进**：Spark 收到一份新提案，计划为 WooCommerce 开发 Fiber Network 支付网关插件，预算 1000 美元、周期 4 周；另一份 Fiber Pay Studio 提案经作者澄清后，正在区分其与既有 Fiber Checkout 工具的不同定位。 [S01, S07] **Spore 元数据标准反复打磨**：Gabriel_Temsten 的提案被委员会标记为 Pending 后，作者紧急修订，明确否认"两个 schema"的误解，强调只交付单一 JSON 元数据标准给非生成式 Spores。 [S03, S04] **AI 辅助开发遇冷**：CCC Vibe-Coding Scaffold 提案经多轮修改后仍被正式拒绝，成为今日唯一被拒的 Spark 提案；同主题的 VibeQuest 则被给予 Pending 机会，需继续完善教育工具属性。 [S08, S09] **Cell 容量租赁市场修正设计**：Carlos_Bunny 在 Cellar 提案下回应技术反馈，承认原设计误把 `since` 当作租赁 cell 的属性，现已围绕...

item.title: Spark Program | Cellar — A Capacity Leasing Market for CKB Cells (1 posts)
item.description: Matt, thanks for catching this. You’re right: the original proposal treated since too much like a property of the leased cell, when on CKB it is actually a CellInput field that constrains a specific spend transaction. I’ve restructured the design around that feedback. The revised Cellar v0 is no longer “lock a cell with since and let the borrower write into it.” Instead, it is a covenant/state-machine model: the active lease cell carries a Cellar type script and Cellar lock script; borrower writes consume the current lease cell and create exactly one valid successor lease cell; the successor must preserve the same lease ID, provider payout lock, borrower lock, principal capacity, expiry,...

item.title: Ckb-viz: read any CKB transaction as a flow of cells (1 posts)
item.description: Quick update on ckb-viz. A few new things landed: Address view — paste a ckb/ckt address to see its CKB balance, token holdings, and recent transactions. Transaction simulator (/simulate) — paste a raw transaction and run it against current chain state: it reports the cycles consumed, or the exact script that fails. The flow renders red and halts when a transaction is rejected. Smaller bits: raw JSON view + copy, off-chain Spore content links, and better error messages. https://ckb-viz.truthixify.dev Feedback and hard-to-decode transaction hashes very welcome.

item.title: PactAgent Developer Update: UI Redesign, DAO/Bounty Workflow Focus, and Agreement Operations Improvements (1 posts)
item.description: Hi Arthur, thanks for the question. PactAgent separates proof review from dispute settlement. When a builder submits proof, the client/reviewer can approve it or request additional information. The builder’s submission alone does not mark the milestone as completed or release payment. If the parties still disagree, either the client or builder can open a milestone dispute and submit supporting evidence. Opening a dispute locks settlement, so funds are not released automatically. PactAgent can analyze the evidence and provide a recommendation, but that recommendation is advisory and still requires human acknowledgement. item.title: Introducing Myelin: a CKB-aligned off-chain Cell session runtime (2 posts)
item.description: I hope everyone’s had a great time with the hackathon and am really looking forward to seeing what fellow builders have come up with. Today, I’m sharing a brand new project that I’m likely to be throwing myself into over the coming months. Myelin in one paragraph Myelin1254×1254 102 KB Myelin is an off-chain Cell session runtime greatly inspired by xuejie’s earlier post. It runs high-throughput, finite state transitions outside CKB and keeps every transition projectable back to a CKB-style transaction. item.title: VeriCell — proof of authorship, integrity and time in live CKB cells (1 posts)
item.description: Hi Nervos community, I’d like to introduce VeriCell (https://vericell.net), live on mainnet: a proof-of-existence and integrity service that anchors SHA-256 file manifests in live cells. A hash proves a file is untampered — but not when it existed, who published it, or where to find the current version. VeriCell uses the cell model to solve all three: Live-cell versioning — a proof is a live cell locked to your wallet. Release a new version and the old cell is consumed into a new one; the transaction chain is the version history. Timestamp and ownership — the block header fixes the time, the lock proves the owner.
